name: v272_earnings_eval_product_slow180
hypothesis: The vector earnings-evaluation fade had good Sharpe but excessive turnover; smoothing the event sentiment and ranking over 180 days should lower turnover without changing the core mechanism.
field_notes: Direct slow-window repair of d5xrYOvJ using verified callable pv13_hierarchy_min5_3000_513_sector.

name: v272_earnings_eval_industry_slow180
hypothesis: If the product taxonomy group is causing sub-universe fragility, the same slow earnings-evaluation fade may be more robust under ordinary industry grouping.
field_notes: Standard group control for d5xrYOvJ, designed to diagnose whether PV13 grouping drives LSUS.

name: v272_earnings_eval_product_largecap_slow
hypothesis: LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE_SHARPE may come from small-cap event noise; gating to larger-cap names should improve robustness while the longer window controls turnover.
field_notes: Uses rank(cap) gate, not Universe fields, to avoid the top1000 unit error seen in v270.

name: v272_earnings_eval_industry_largecap_slow
hypothesis: A large-cap industry-ranked version is the cleanest robustness test for whether the high Sharpe survives without product-group small-cap effects.
field_notes: Cap-gated standard grouping control for the near-miss.

name: v272_earnings_eval_product_sga_stabilized
hypothesis: A small low-turnover SG&A investment-intensity sleeve may stabilize the high-turnover earnings-evaluation fade, but this is a final mixed test because standalone SG&A was weak.
field_notes: Uses only 35% SG&A sign-flip sleeve from XgpAVb08; abandon if Fitness/LSUS does not clear.
